references.supports: Power-on vector fetch, SP fetch, VBR=0, SR.I=15; unspecified GPRs are scenario poison, not reset zero claims.
ICR NMIL read-only reflects explicit NMI pin; priority and exception boundary.
BCR1,BCR2,WCR,RAMER addresses/reset; RAMER nonzero remains a frontier.
SYSCR2 word key3C and clock selector; no implicit oscillator timing.
WDT keyed writes, reserved read bits, TCNT divisors, interval versus watchdog. Header prose TCSR00 conflicts with register table18 only in reserved read-as-one bits; model uses architectural read18.
Both HCAN MCR reset1 and GSR reset0C; explicit idle/no-traffic configuration permits register reset release. Finite flags and mailbox writes only; no transmitted frame or timed synchronization claim.
SH7058 FPSCR read-only DN/RM=40001 and writable-mask18C60. Device-defined fixed bits are retained despite truncated software-manual mask pseudocode.
Finite PFC/port word-write addresses; no read latch/pin equivalence and no electrical model.
